Team,

Thanks again for the greenlight overnight. This thread is the working record for the coordination and immediate stabilization sweep after the cutover. Summary of the plan for today (times in PT):

- 09:30 — pre-flight quick check (KV cache warm, LB health ok, ACLs applied).
- 10:30 — canary traffic (5% traffic; 10 minutes).
- 11:00 — ramp to 100% if canary passes.
- 11:15–12:30 — smoke validation window (end-to-end ops, auth, telemetry, backups).

Critical gating items (we cannot proceed if any fail):
- KV cache hit rate < 60% on primaries.
- >1/3 hosts failing health checks.
- Persistent 5xx > 0.5% at the edge for >5 minutes.

Attachments: redwood-postcutover-runbook_v2.pdf — follow the step-by-step runbook. Please confirm the firewall/ingress rules are in place (ports 443, 9411 for tracing, 9300-9302 for cluster mgmt). If Acme needs temporary monitoring access, we have a 2-hour jumpbox token that expires at 13:00 PT — tell me who should receive it.

Action: Daniel — confirm last-mile ACLs and whether your team will watch the canary metrics live. Laura — stand by to run the smoke playbook and capture the smoke-results CSV. Rishi — I'll hand the stabilization readout to you when we have canary results.

E

Canary run complete — summary below and attached CSV + network trace. Full output is in smoke-results-edge-20261105.csv (attached).

Summary (10:30–10:40 PT):
- Latency P50: 48ms, P95: 210ms (within target).
- 5xx rate: 0.02% (one transient auth error, auto-retried).
- KV cache hit rate: 81% (warm).
- Host health: 9/10 hosts healthy; 1 host showed intermittent LB fail (BGP route flap detected, auto-healed).

Notes: The LB fail correlated with a transient route flap on node edge-07 — logs attached (network-trace-20261105.txt). We cycled the interface and the host rejoined; no persistent errors after 10:36. All other validation checks in the runbook passed (auth, tracing, metrics ingestion, backup snapshots triggered and completed).

Recommendation: Proceed to ramp to 100% at 11:00 PT. I'll start the smoke validation window at 11:15 and post the full checklist results by 12:30.

Attachments: smoke-results-edge-20261105.csv, network-trace-20261105.txt
